items: Summary: The target number adversaries roll against to hit a PC.
When: Use when resolving adversary attacks.
Not When: Do not treat it as D&D armor class in every other context.
Answer: The closest Daggerheart equivalent is Evasion.
Example: Barnacle's Evasion is high, making him harder to hit.
